description: 13-jurisdiction margins with donor_flat as the base scenario and stumpage_scaled as the sensitivity; QC T20 direct costs and the BC IAM road-maintenance allowance replace donor values where published. Coverage remains partial.

decision.reason: The v2.1 price decision is retained. v2.2 upgrades only cost cells with published direct evidence and keeps donor values elsewhere.

qc_cost_upgrade.basis: MRNF 2022 T20 SEPM synthesis before transfers; road gross; regional min/max range; not observed transaction

licensing.statement: No strict-open claim is made. Provincial rate pages, PDFs and spreadsheets are public-reference copyrighted sources. Only extracted rates, URLs and hashes are redistributed; source documents are not.

Coast CAD/ha values are not converted to CAD/m3.
